standard_prerequisites.name: The internal hom construction in the derived category of O-modules commutes with localization
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces parts (1) and (2) to affine opens of X.

standard_prerequisites.name: On affines the derived quasi-coherent categories compare with module categories, pseudo-coherent and perfect objects correspond to bounded above and finite complexes of finite projective modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces (1) and (2) to the affine statement (3).

standard_prerequisites.name: The internal hom of complexes represented by finite projective complexes is computed termwise, by the cohomology Rhom lemma for complexes of direct summands of finite free modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Proves part (3) in both the pseudo-coherent and the perfect case.

standard_prerequisites.name: On a ringed space the nth cohomology sheaf of the internal hom is the sheaf associated to the presheaf of Ext groups on opens
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the presheaf formula of part (4) on principal opens.

core_obligations: Localize: the internal hom commutes with localization of the ringed space, so parts (1) and (2) may be checked on affine opens; by the affine comparison, the pseudo-coherent-affine and perfect-affine lemmas it suffices to prove part (3) (proof lines 2687-2693).

Part (3): represent K by a bounded above (resp. finite) complex of finite projective A-modules and L by a bounded below (resp. arbitrary) complex of A-modules; the cohomology lemma computing the internal hom of such complexes gives R SheafHom(K-tilde, L-tilde) = the sheaf associated to R Hom_A(K, L) in both cases (proof lines 2695-2699).

Part (4): on any ringed space H^n(R SheafHom(A, B)) is the sheaf associated to U mapsto Ext^n_{D(O_U)}(A|_U, B|_U); on a principal open D(f) the restrictions of K-tilde and L-tilde are the images of K tensor A_f and L tensor A_f, so the affine comparison gives the displayed presheaf formula (proof lines 2701-2715).
proof_roadmap: Reduce (1) and (2) to the affine statement (3) (proof lines 2687-2693).
Prove (3) by representing K and L with finite projective complexes and computing the internal hom termwise (proof lines 2695-2699).
Prove (4) from the presheaf description of internal hom cohomology on principal opens (proof lines 2701-2715).
